name: langchain-allow-dangerous-code-enabled
attack_scenario: The dataframe agent is asked a question that makes the LLM emit df.query("@__import__('os').system('id')"); because the dangerous-code guard is off, the payload is exec()'d server-side.
negative_test_hint: prompt the agent so it emits "@__import__('os').system('id')" in the generated code and assert it is never exec'd server-side because the dangerous-code guard stays on

exemplar.compliant: agent = create_pandas_dataframe_agent(llm, df, allow_dangerous_code=False)  # keep the guard on; use a sandboxed executor if code is truly needed
exemplar.explanation: allow_dangerous_code=True is the explicit opt-in LangChain requires before create_pandas_dataframe_agent / create_csv_agent / experimental agents will exec() model-generated Python. Setting it True re-enables the exact RCE path LangChain gated behind the flag.
